description: AWS SDK v1 -> 2.x (cloud-sdk) upgrade of shipping-instruction on branch feature/ION-16396-si-aws-upgrade (from origin/develop b86d536f). entries.summary: Scope: 62 v1 main files / 8 test. 48 DynamoDB bean classes, CloudFormation with NO cloud-sdk wrapper, NO AWS4Signer, NO commons messaging.* usage. Module dir is shipping-instruction (singular) and had NO docs/ folder.
entries.detail:
Real directory is `shipping-instruction` (singular) — the task brief called it "shipping-instructions"/"shipment-instructions". It had NO docs/ directory at all, so (contrary to the brief) there was no initial design doc to refer to; the design was derived from source, poms, per-env configs and the reference modules.

v1 import histogram (src/main):
  services.dynamodbv2.datamodeling.*  100   -> cloud-sdk DatabaseRepository + v2 Enhanced annotations
  services.cloudformation(+.model)      9   -> DIRECT AWS SDK v2 (no cloud-sdk wrapper exists)
  services.lambda.runtime.events       10   -> KEEP (event POJOs, not SDK clients)
  services.dynamodbv2(.model)          10
  waiters.{Waiter,WaiterParameters}     2   -> v2 CloudFormationWaiter
  services.s3                           2   -> cloud-sdk StorageClient
  ClientConfiguration / client.builder  2
  util                                  2

Annotation histogram (the bulk of the work):
  @DynamoDBDocument           46  -> nested @DynamoDbBean
  @DynamoDBTypeConvertedEnum  25  -> nothing (Enhanced default stores enums as S via name())
  @DynamoDBIgnore             20  -> @DynamoDbIgnore ON THE GETTER
  @DynamoDBAttribute          15  -> @DynamoDbAttribute
  @DynamoDBTypeConverted       3  -> @DynamoDbConvertedBy
  @DynamoDBTable               2  -> @DynamoDbBean + cloud-sdk @Table(name=)
  @DynamoDBHashKey             2  -> @DynamoDbPartitionKey
  @DynamoDBIndexHashKey        2  -> @DynamoDbSecondaryPartitionKey
  @DynamoDBRangeKey            1  -> @DynamoDbSortKey
  @DynamoDBStream              1  -> cloud-sdk @Stream  (LOAD-BEARING, see separate entry)
  @DynamoDBAutoGeneratedKey    1  -> NO v2 EQUIVALENT (see separate entry)

Entities:
  model/SIVersion.java          -> table "si"     : @DynamoDBStream(KEYS_ONLY), HASH + auto-generated RANGE,
                                                    GSI INTTRA_REFERENCE_NUMBER_INDEX,
                                                    @DynamoDBTypeConverted(CompressionConverter),
                                                    @DynamoDBTypeConverted(DateToEpochSecond)
  model/dynamodb/DynamoDBSIDraft.java -> table "siDraft": @DynamoDBHashKey(attributeName=PRIMARY_KEY_ATTRIBUTE) (RENAMED KEY),
                                                    @DynamoDBTypeConverted(SIDraftConverter),
                                                    GSI DRAFT_ORACLE_DRAFT_ID_INDEX
Support: dao/SIDao (49L), dao/DynamoSupport (75L, module-local copy as in VAS), dynamodb/SIDraftDao (111L),
         model/dynamodb/SIDraftConverter (21L), config/CloudFormationCommand (122L), lambda/S3ArchiveHandler (110L)

TWO SIMPLIFICATIONS vs expectation:
 - NO AWS4Signer anywhere: the 5 Elasticsearch classes use RestHighLevelClient WITHOUT AWS request signing, so
   (unlike visibility-inbound) there is NO need to retain aws-java-sdk-core for ES. Elasticsearch stays untouched.
 - ZERO commons messaging.* usage, so the commons 1.0.28 bump does NOT cascade into SQS/SNS/event-logging here
   (contrast booking-cargoscreen/ION-16397, where it breaks 11 files).

entries.summary: THREE high risks: @DynamoDBAutoGeneratedKey has no v2 equivalent; field->getter annotation move can silently rename attributes on live data; Streams on `si` feed a CloudFormation-deployed Lambda
entries.detail:
RISK 1 — @DynamoDBAutoGeneratedKey on the `si` SORT key. v1's mapper generates a UUID for the range key on save when
null. AWS SDK v2 Enhanced has NO equivalent (@DynamoDbAutoGeneratedTimestampAttribute is a different thing).
Options considered: generate in the getter (REJECTED — side-effect in a getter, BeanTableSchema may call it more than
once); custom DynamoDbExtension (REJECTED — over-engineered for one null check).
CHOSEN: generate explicitly in SIDao.save(...) before handing the item to the repository. Preserves
"null => generate, non-null => keep" exactly. MUST be pinned by a test on BOTH branches — getting it wrong either
breaks writes or silently overwrites existing versions.

RISK 2 — v1 annotates FIELDS, v2 Enhanced requires annotations on GETTERS (plus public no-arg ctor + setters). A
field-level @DynamoDbAttribute is SILENTLY IGNORED, which renames the attribute on disk and makes live items
unreadable. Across 48 bean classes this cannot be caught by eyeballing. The gate is DynamoDB-Local ITs that assert
RAW ITEM SHAPES (not just round-trips — a round-trip-only test passes even if every attribute were renamed), plus a
v1-writes / v2-reads compatibility test (the VAS pattern).
Convert bottom-up: leaf artifacts (model/Common/Artifacts/*) -> composites -> the 2 root entities, compiling continuously.

RISK 3 — Streams on `si` are @DynamoDBStream(StreamViewType.KEYS_ONLY) and MUST stay enabled and KEYS_ONLY. The
CloudFormation stack `int-si-ddb-to-s3-lambda` is what wires that stream to the archive Lambda
(parameter TableStreamSNSTopic = arn:aws:sns:us-east-1:081020446316:inttra_int_sns_pi_si), so this is functional, not
cosmetic. Use cloud-sdk @Stream and assert the view type in a table-command IT.

ALSO: preserve the CloudFormation template resource path VERBATIM — it is `cloudFormatiom/template.json` (the typo is
in the existing config; renaming it breaks the deploy).

EXPECTED cloud-sdk gap that APPLIES HERE: DynamoDbAdminCommand derives the partition-key attribute name from the bean
PROPERTY name, ignoring @DynamoDbAttribute. DynamoDBSIDraft uses @DynamoDBHashKey(attributeName=PRIMARY_KEY_ATTRIBUTE),
i.e. a RENAMED key, so a fresh-environment create would provision the wrong key name. No live impact (tables exist,
command is idempotent describe-then-skip) but must be asserted + documented.

entries.summary: STATE: design complete, implementation NOT started. Branch feature/ION-16396-si-aws-upgrade at origin/develop b86d536f, 0 outgoing commits, no upstream set. Full-migration scope confirmed by user.
entries.detail:
Model: Claude Opus 5. Stopped deliberately before implementation at the user's instruction ("I do not want you to start implementing on an exhausted session context").

USER DECISION: full migration in ONE commit — DynamoDB mapper -> v2 Enhanced (all 48 bean classes) + S3 -> StorageClient
+ CloudFormation -> direct AWS SDK v2 + commons 1.0.28-SNAPSHOT. (Alternatives offered and rejected: defer DynamoDB, or
defer CloudFormation — both would have left AWS SDK v1 on the prod classpath.)

DONE: branch created from origin/develop (b86d536f), upstream tracking explicitly UNSET; design doc written.
Verified in ~/.m2: commons, cloud-sdk-api, cloud-sdk-aws, dynamo-integration-test all present at 1.0.28-SNAPSHOT.

NOT DONE — next actions, in order (design doc section 10):
 1. Baseline: shaded jar + OWASP -> C:\temp\latest-dep-chk-reports\shipping-instruction\baseline\; record test counts + boot state
 2. javap the exact cloud-sdk surface (DatabaseRepository, DynamoRepositoryFactory, DynamoDbAdminCommand,
    @Table/@Stream/@GsiConfig, BaseDynamoDbConfig) and the 3 v1 converters to be ported
 3. Verify LIVE INT `si` / `siDraft` tables (describe-table, describe-time-to-live) as the parity oracle
 4. pom + SIConfig + config.yaml x4 envs (dynamoDbConfig -> BaseDynamoDbConfig; REMOVE dynamoDbTableConfig block;
    cloudFormationConfig UNCHANGED)
 5. Convert 46 nested beans bottom-up (leaf -> composite), compiling continuously
 6. Convert the 2 root entities incl. @Stream, GSIs, auto-generated-key decision
 7. Port CompressionConverter, SIDraftConverter, DateToEpochSecond as v2 AttributeConverters — BYTE-IDENTICAL
 8. Migrate SIDao + SIDraftDao; DELETE module-local DynamoSupport; add a DynamoModule + repository provider
 9. Rewrite the table-admin command on cloud-sdk DynamoDbAdminCommand, KEEPING the registered Dropwizard command name
    (check the old name FIRST) so the CI $task does not change
10. Migrate CloudFormationCommand to direct v2 + CloudFormationWaiter (waitUntilStackCreateComplete/UpdateComplete)
11. Migrate S3ArchiveHandler (S3 + its ClientConfiguration tuning) and IndexerHandler — with EXPLICIT region AND
    credentials provider (ION-16387 outage class: BaseAwsConfig validation throws
    "CredentialsProvider must not be null" at cold start if omitted). Assert non-null in a test.
12. Add DynamoDB-Local ITs + failsafe/native-lib plugin wiring (junit-platform exclusions per the cargo-viz precedent);
    retype the 8 v1 test files
13. mvn -pl shipping-instruction -am clean verify — ALL tests green, none weakened/@Disabled
14. Boot-check java -jar .../shipping-instruction-1.0.jar server conf/int/config.yaml (continue-on-INT-like-failure rule,
    with evidence)
15. Post OWASP -> ...\post\ ; HIGH/CRITICAL delta
16. VS Code Run/Debug for com.inttra.mercury.shippinginstruction.SIApplication (.vscode is git-ignored)
17. ONE commit, message contains ION-16396, verify rev-list --count origin/develop..HEAD == 1, DO NOT PUSH

CONSTRAINTS: single outgoing commit; message must contain ION-16396 (Bitbucket git-control-freak hook); do not push
before user review; no test weakened or disabled; Oracle DB / Elasticsearch / REST API all out of scope and untouched.

Sonar gate is 80% on new code; **/model/** is likely excluded, so coverage weight falls on the DAOs, converters, the
admin command and the CloudFormation command.
